title: Rockstar Officially Responds to Recent Leaks Ahead of Extended Look
description: Rockstar Games has issued an official statement addressing the recent wave of GTA VI leaks, calling the situation heartbreaking while reaffirming that tomorrow's Extended Look showcase and the November 19 release date remain on schedule.
article_content:
Rockstar Games has officially addressed the widespread leaks that surfaced over the past week, expressing disappointment while assuring fans that development and promotional plans remain firmly on track.

In a statement published across their official channels, the studio called the unauthorized leaks heartbreaking for the development team, noting that early and unfinished footage does not represent the intended experience. Rockstar cautioned the community about potential story and gameplay spoilers circulating online and urged players to wait for official material.

Despite the leak situation, Rockstar reaffirmed that tomorrow's Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look will premiere as scheduled, followed by the global launch on November 19, 2026.
